# LocalKeyRemapper

> LocalKeyRemapper is a native, privacy-first, security-first and accessibility-first keyboard remapper for macOS.

LocalKeyRemapper is an open-source macOS utility focused exclusively on keyboard remapping.

It allows users to create custom profiles, configurable remapping rules, global and per-profile shortcuts, modifier-aware mappings, bidirectional mappings and exceptions.

The application runs locally on the user's Mac.

No accounts, analytics, telemetry, cloud services, Internet connection or keystroke history are used.

LocalKeyRemapper requires macOS 13.5 or later and Accessibility permission to intercept and remap keyboard events.

## Website

- [Home](https://localkeyremapper.github.io/): Overview of LocalKeyRemapper, its features, design principles, privacy, security, accessibility and native macOS approach.
- [Download](https://localkeyremapper.github.io/download.html): Official options for downloading the ready-to-use macOS application or accessing the source code.
- [Installation](https://localkeyremapper.github.io/install.html): Step-by-step instructions for installing the DMG, opening the application and granting Accessibility permission.

## Important information

- LocalKeyRemapper is designed for macOS.
- The minimum supported operating system is macOS 13.5.
- Keyboard remapping requires explicit macOS Accessibility permission.
- All remapping is performed locally on the Mac.
- The application does not require an account or Internet connection.
- The project does not use analytics, telemetry or cloud services.
- The source code is publicly inspectable.
- Official compiled builds should be obtained only from the official LocalKeyRemapper GitHub repository and its Releases page.
